title: Steel Erection Job Safety Analysis
description: Free Steel Erection Job Safety Analysis template for construction you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers project information, job steps & hazard analysis.
standard: OSHA 29 Cfr 1926 Subpart R - Steel Erection
html:
Project Information

JSA ID: STEEL-__________ DATE: ______________ TIME: ______________

PROJECT: ______________ LOCATION: ______________ STRUCTURE: ______________

CONNECTOR: ______________ CRANE OPERATOR: ______________ CREW SIZE: ______________

Job Steps & Hazard Analysis

JOB STEPHAZARDS IDENTIFIEDPOTENTIAL CONSEQUENCERISK RATING (L x S)CONTROL MEASURES
1. Material Handling & Storage-Unstable storage
-Improper rigging		-Rollover
-Crush injuries
-Dropped load		16 (HIGH)-Store on level ground
-Chock/block all material
-Separate by size/type
-Inspect lifting lugs
2. Crane Operations for Steel-Overloading
-Swing radius workers
-Communication failure		-Tip over
-Struck by load
-Collision		20 (VERY HIGH)-Verify load weight
-Check crane capacity chart
-Barricade swing area
-Use dedicated signal person
-Test radio communication
3. Connecting Steel (Height)-Unstable connections
-Missing bolts
-Unguarded edges		-Fall from height
-Dropped tools
-Structural collapse		25 (VERY HIGH)-100% tie-off at all times
-Use double lanyards
-Connect to fixed anchor points
-Use tool lanyards
-Install bolts immediately
4. Plumbing & Aligning-Moving under suspended load
-Pinch points
-Wrenches		-Crush injuries
-Amputations
-Tool drop		12 (HIGH)-Check swing path before moving
-Use tag lines
-Never place hands between members
-Use spud wrenches with lanyards
5. Bolting & Decking-Open holes
-Unsecured decking
-Missing covers		-Fall through
-Fall from height
-Impalement		20 (VERY HIGH)-Cover or guard floor openings
-Install perimeter cables
-Secure decking immediately
-Install warning lines
-Use safety nets if required
6. Final Connection Inspection-Unbolted connections
-Missing cross braces		-Structural instability
-Collapse		16 (HIGH)-Verify all connections
-Torque check critical bolts
-Inspect welds
-Document inspections

FALL PROTECTION: ☐ Full Body Harness ☐ 6ft Lanyard ☐ Self-Retracting Lifeline ☐ Anchor Points @ ____________

REQUIRED PPE: ☐ Hard Hat ☐ Safety Glasses ☐ High-Vis Vest ☐ Steel-Toe Boots ☐ Gloves ☐ Fall Protection
